research(C23A): bind external source contracts and validate sandbox components

Add current intake, P19 positive photo-subflow with 826 frozen exposures, FS2010 finite spectral precontraction, and conditional neutron/T beta energy-domain coverage. Preserve failed attempts and independent reviews. No completed cosmological rerun or physical full-network adoption; global error bound remains null.

docs(C23A): preserve verified delivery and resume after executor failure

Publish exact recovered final authority, actual Library/Dropbox R3 receipts, final stages and next DAG, environment-failure record, and copyable handoff. Preserve Drive UNKNOWN_NO_ACK. All scientific results are reused; no completed calculation is rerun.

docs(C23A): seal terminal delivery verification after interruption

Record exact science/document commits, eight affected-document byte readbacks, actual archive/authority dual R3 receipts, and remaining Drive/executor gates. No new science.

research(C23B): add verified PW19 supply and source-frame operators

Add three-redshift ground-state photoelectron supply, stable isotropic Lorentz kernels, proper decay clocks, positive finite-table contraction and conservative primary-source assembly. Preserve immutable executed revisions, targeted guard corrections, independent reviews and saved-only figures.

Scope: nine new spectral cases and 49 finite contractions; no new ODE or historical campaign reruns. Low-energy stopping, isotope/gas admission and full thermochemical/radiative closure remain open.

docs(C23B): bind scientific authority, dual byte-verified delivery and next DAG

Record actual C23B source/run identities, 371 remote file bindings and 453 restored delivery members; retain targeted revision history and scoped physics limits. Bind Library and Dropbox byte/CRC/member-SHA readbacks. Preserve the unacknowledged small Drive document attempt separately from older uncertainty.

Add final stage records and a copyable handoff for low-energy stopping and atomic/isotope coverage. The containing document commit is bound by an external transport receipt.

docs(C23B): seal actual terminal transport receipts

Record exact science and document commits, dual provider R3 readbacks for the main archive, final authority and final-documents ZIP, and the unacknowledged Drive probe. Preserve scope and next stopping/atomic-coverage DAG. No new science.
